humanDecision.competitorAndAttributeInputs: select authorized saved sources and generate; uploads supplemental

changes: Implement dedicated saved-competitor single-item durable analysis. UI freezes explicit ids/revisions for selected or all eligible project records, submits independently, retains partial failure outcomes and polls safe task DTOs; selecting one creates exactly one task. No server-side reselection or mandatory upload.

One deterministic owner/workspace/project/analysis/source-hash anchor. Reserved -> model_dispatched -> analysis_ready -> analysis_committed checkpoints; model-dispatch unknown state never automatically recalls a model. Explicit safe resume stays on the original runId.

Real domain transactions repeat current actor/policy, parent ownership, source, full-row revision, Agent/N1 cancellation and SQL worker/attempt/unexpired-lease checks. Source changes, human edits and confirmation cannot be overwritten by a late result.

Atomically save a draft competitor result, increment its summaryVersion, create immutable draft evidence and safe audit metadata, and finalize the job receipt. Human-edited summary remains; current model fields are replaced or removed together so planners do not mix old advantages/weaknesses. Original sources/review pair are retained.

Use the current user listing.competitor.analyze Skill, require Released snapshot, bind version/system prompt through the existing runner API and validate returned Skill identity/version/system/manifest hashes. One attempt and no fallback. This is not complete pre-dispatch manifest/model pinning.

Project/run scope is rechecked for writes, project/read for histories, project/cancel for cancellation. Bad/missing source rows expose only safe historical DTOs and cannot resume; unrelated rows remain visible. Missing Agent metadata does not prevent authorized cancellation.

Worker explicitly registers the new kind. Generic job payload/read/retry/cancel/confirmation routes exclude both checkpointed Listing kinds; SQL claim and worker updates share precise lease fences. Read-only binding audit excludes these kinds before LIMIT. Other kind behavior retained.

Source context includes saved Listing claims and explicitly secondary review analysis; actual review originals and image pixels are not read. An 80 KiB source bound rejects oversized context without silent truncation. Trusted source/progress flags are not supplied by model output.

UI preserves selected comparison/report drafts on completion; explicit scope/user/epoch guards discard late replies. Lost acknowledgments trigger status reads, not automatic mutation retries. Cancellation does not promise provider termination or refunds. History is labeled latest 100 tasks.

Product attributes retain the prior saved-profile selection/preview/durable conversion lane. User seven directions, FABE, provenance and fact/core/candidate review stay unchanged. Workflow flag stays opt-in/off by default.

review.independent: Pure-source and cross-layer reviewers found and closed stale top-level AI field reuse and unverified returned Skill identity; root also requested malformed historical source isolation, missing-Agent cancellation and completed-anchor race tests. Actual MySQL concurrency/rollback, lease recovery, worker scheduling, scoped browser no-upload flow and real Skill execution remain unaccepted. These offline tests are not production or P4/P5 acceptance.

Existing generic automatic acquisition/import AI paths are unchanged and do not inherit this new lane's model-dispatch protocol. Parent project deletion's reverse lock order and all unrelated comparison/report APIs still need runtime/security work.

Current runtime API pre-dispatch pins version and system prompt only. Manifest is checked on returned result; saved userPrompt hash is provenance. This batch does not pin a model or certify immutable user/Qingdao production Skill snapshots.

Same source is intentionally not automatically reanalyzed after a successful/unknown run. Original-client stale revisions may return conflict and require readback; manual inspection is required for unknown model outcomes.
Admin worker runtime status retains run-id metadata; not all administrative metadata is hidden. No generalized all-site isolation claim.
Native303 remains UNAPPROVED, native/0230/P1 gates and all original plan requirements remain. No production, public push, paid model, scheduler, VM or heavy build action.
